1× Harlo OS · Diagnostics + 3-Month RMA. may i know what is this ?

That line is our **Diagnostics + 3-Month RMA**, Winson. It's a free add-on to your order, and its full name now is just "Diagnostics + 3-Month RMA". Older orders like yours still show "Harlo OS" in the name, but it doesn't include Harlo OS.

It covers two things. Our technical team will diagnose your Thor P2 if something goes wrong, and you have 3 months of RMA cover if a fault needs a return or replacement.

So your power supply fan question is covered by it. Our tech specialist is looking at your photo first.
